brief: Moves a text in and out: saves it to a file, loads it from one, and renders it as a JSON, CSV, XML or HTML value.
detail: Build one with new stzStringIO("text"). ToFile (also SaveTo, ExportTo), AppendToFile and PrependToFile write the text held; FromFile (also LoadFrom) replaces it with a file's content, read as UTF-8, and raises when the file is missing. ToJSON, ToCSV, ToXML and ToHTML only return a rendering. IsFilePath, IsURL, IsEmail and IsBase64 are quick shape tests, not validations. FromClipboard is a placeholder that always raises. Use an invented path of your own when you try the file methods.
receiver: o1 = new stzStringIO("say " + char(34) + "hi" + char(34) + ", שלום")
